goal: Tightens the internal state machine of the UTXO coins cache so invalid states can no longer be represented
Fixes a latent bug where repeated spends of an already-spent cached coin could overwrite caller-owned data
reviewability: Ready to review, all reviewer questions were addressed and the latest commit got a fresh reACK
Independent fuzzing found no issues with the newly added asserts
agreement: Strong support with a detailed maintainability rationale and a reACK on the final commit (optout21)
Concept ACK and co-authorship on several commits (andrewtoth)
Verified by two hours of fuzzing with no crashes or sanitizer hits (ptrinh)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes a real bug in SpendCoin that could overwrite caller-owned data on a repeated spend
It also removes previously representable but invalid cache states, reducing future bug surface for validation reviewers
This is groundwork making the UTXO cache safer to change rather than a consensus-rule change itself

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it tightens an invariant in the LevelDB-backed coins database write path so only dirty entries are ever written
This hardens an existing invariant rather than fixing an observed corruption or adding new functionality
Impact is real but narrow, limited to the on-disk coins database layer
